expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Includes types.ts, useSelection.ts, api.ts, BulkActionsBar.tsx with TypedConfirm subcomponent, DocumentsTable.tsx with full implementations

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: All code is executable React/TypeScript, not pseudocode or recommendations

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Soft-delete endpoint, undo toast with undoToken-based undo call: await documentsApi.undo(result.undoToken)

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: All {fmt(p.count)} matching documents selected; Archive {fmt(p.count)}; Delete {fmt(p.count)}

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Selection has 'ids' vs 'all' modes; selectAllMatching explicitly defined; UI shows 'Select all {totalMatching} matching' only when page is all-selected and more exist

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Visual divider <span aria-hidden className="mx-1 h-5 w-px bg-blue-200" />; archive blue styling, delete red styling (border-red-300, text-red-700)

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive button first; Delete button secondary with red styling; autoFocus only on TypedConfirm input when confirmation needed

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Server contract section: bulk endpoints must be soft, honour Idempotency-Key, resolve {mode:'all'} with same filter semantics as pagination

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closes with 'What this makes impossible, and at which rung' followed by explicit list: stale selection after filter change, double-submit, reflexive delete of thousands, misreading scale
